message: Hi, my little one Ellie is 6 and wants to try jiu jitsu. Do you have classes for that age?

Hi! Yes, we do! We have a Kids 6-8 Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu program that would be perfect for Ellie. She can try it out with a free trial class, no commitment required. Would you like to get her signed up for a trial?
Yes, I’d love to sign her up for a trial class! What time do you have available?
Great! I just need a few quick details to get your trial set up. What's your name?
Perfect, thanks Tester! And what's the best email to send the trial class details to?
Got it! And can I grab your phone number? Just so we can reach you if anything comes up with the class.
Perfect! Last thing - can I get Ellie's full name and date of birth? That helps us get her set up in the system.
Of course! Her name is Ellie Cypress, and her birthday is January 15, 2020.

Awesome! I have Ellie all set. Here are some available times for her Kids Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu trial class:

Tuesday 7/7 at 5:30 PM
Thursday 7/9 at 5:30 PM
Saturday 7/11 at 11:00 AM

Which works best for you?
Let's go with Tuesday, July 7 at 5:30 PM. Thank you!

Perfect! Ellie is all booked for Tuesday, July 7 at 5:30 PM for her free trial class. We'll send a confirmation to tester.cypress@gmail.com. Just have her wear comfortable clothes she can move in. See you then!
